name: Misumi Ryoko
source:
Mizusumino Academy - Music Teacher (Temporary Instructor)

She acts like a kind older sister who knows about Yukina and Akari’s family backgrounds and is always looking out for them.
She lives near Yukina and has looked after her in various ways since she was little.
